name: WMH Heterogeneous Clinical MRI Dataset
description: A new dataset of heterogeneous clinical MRI scans with white matter hyperintensity (WMH) annotations and associated evaluation results to test segmentation methods under clinical variability.
reputation: A clinical WMH dataset of interest to the medical imaging community for testing robustness across heterogeneous scanners and protocols; moderate awareness but not as widely used as some large public brain MRI benchmarks.
notes: Heterogeneous clinical scans introduce domain shift and label variability; dataset may be relatively small and exhibit class imbalance (small lesion volumes). Non-LLM benchmark focused on medical image segmentation; careful preprocessing and cross-site validation are important.
